rationale: Confirmation check pass for EPMCDME-8510: All acceptance criteria and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards verified. Automated tests pass cleanly (vitest 56/56 in components/Accordion, 627/627 in pages/assistants), TypeScript typecheck passes with 0 errors, and ESLint reports clean. Zero blocking findings.

business_review.notes: Verified high contrast focus-visible ring styles using border-accent design token.

business_review.criterion: Keyboard navigation via Tab/Shift+Tab displays visible focus ring on Accordion headers
business_review.notes: Verified with Accordion.test.tsx and in-browser manual test.

business_review.criterion: FormAccordion and FormNestedAccordion headers display visible focus indicators
business_review.notes: Pass-through preset applied with rounded-t-lg and focus-visible rings.
